language: selected target implementation language. Allowed values: `triton`, `tilelang`, `ascendc`.

api.kind: public API form preserved from the original operator. Allowed values: `torch-function` or `torch-module`.
api.name: public API symbol name preserved from the original operator.
api.signature: call signature of the public API as a compact human-readable string.
api.inputs: ordered input contract preserved from the original operator. Each input entry records the argument name, dtype, shape, device, and any other semantic constraints needed to generate deterministic tests.
api.outputs: ordered output contract preserved from the original operator. Each output entry records dtype, shape, device, and any other semantic constraints needed to generate deterministic tests.

kernels: ordered list of kernels planned for the converted implementation. Each item records a name and a short description of what the kernel does. Do not pin kernel signatures; finalize them during implementation.

semantics.operation: short description of what the operator computes, derived from the original operator.
semantics.edge_cases: important semantic edge cases, shape constraints, rounding boundaries, or other conditions that the conversion must preserve.

testing.plan: resolved test coverage plan: the existing suitable test file and mode to reuse, or the standalone or differential test cases to generate when no suitable test exists.
